item.title: Global cooperation adapts under pressure but remains below what the world needs - WEF
item.description: The Barometer, now in its third year and developed in collaboration with McKinsey & Company, shows that while overall levels of global cooperation have remained broadly unchanged in recent years, the form of cooperation is shifting.

item.title: South Africa's naval drills with Russia, China risk US, EU trade fallout, experts warn
item.description: A general view of the Chinese guided- missile destroyer Tangshan, right, and the Chinese comprehensive supply ship Taihu, left, moored in False Bay, close to Simon’s Town, near Cape Town, this week. The People’s Republic of China will lead a joint, interagency, inter-departmental, multinational exercise in South African waters from Friday. Exercise WILL FOR PEACE 2026 brings together navies from BRICS Plus countries.

item.title: SA forges ahead with Chinese, Iranian, Russian military drills despite US standoff
item.description: A general view of (L-R) the Chinese guided-missile destroyer Tangshan (Hull 122), the Iranian navy ship, the IRIS Makran 441, Chinese comprehensive supply ship Taihu (Hull 889) in the Simon's Town harbour. item.title: No snub detected: Lhuan-dre Pretorius was kept in the loop by Proteas' Shukri Conrad
item.description: Lhuan-dre Pretorius, a promising 19-year-old South African cricketer, was kept informed by coach Shukri Conrad about not being selected for the Proteas T20 World Cup squad, acknowledging his future potential and celebrating teammate Kwena Maphaka’s inclusion. Picture: Carl Fourie/SA20
